title: Great app
body:
I love it, I've been using it for a couple of months now.

However, a couple of things stand out 
1. The recent change in UI makes me get less satisfaction out the habit completion. It actually makes it frustrating because:
2. Habits that I created in the trial are locked forever, without any means of deleting or editing them.
3. These dead habits show up first in my list for today. In the compact view I can tick the current habit with no fuss, but pressing a plus is less satisfying than holding on the circle and seeing the bubble get filled up.
4. In the big view I have to scroll down to find my active habit. 

For a simple habit tracker I still find it overpriced, even for the yearly version. I know 80 bucks is not a huge cost in a couple of countries, but if the purpose is to help as many people as possible, 80 bucks is quite steep for the value given compared to average salary in a lot of countries.
